x-business-rules: Users authenticate with an email and password and receive a signed JWT access token.
A user can belong to multiple companies with the owner or member role.
Only company owners can add, remove, or change the role of company members.
Every company must retain at least one owner.
Every project belongs to exactly one company and is visible only to that company's members.
New versions start with status pending and planned todos are not dispatched until the version is ready or in-progress.
All newly created todos start with status draft and do not create a branch.
WIP todos have versionId null and status draft.
Changing an assigned todo from draft to planned creates its branch from the version branch.
A WIP todo can only be assigned to a pending, ready, or in-progress version. Assignment sets status to planned and creates its branch.
Todos cannot be added to complete or released versions.
Only pending versions can be deleted; deleting one also removes its todos.
Only draft todos can be deleted.
Project versions and their todos are ordered by createdAt descending.
Only a todo with status done and isMerged false can be merged.
Only a version with status complete can be released. Releasing sets status to released and releasedAt to the server timestamp.
Released versions are immutable except for administrative correction.
The backend assigns IDs, timestamps, issueNumber, and issueUrl. Clients must not generate authoritative values for these fields.
Mutating endpoints should execute atomically and return HTTP 409 when a concurrent or invalid workflow transition is detected.

x-frontend-integration.responseShape: Successful response bodies are the schema shown for each endpoint. useApi wraps the Axios response as { data: responseBody }; the backend should not add another data wrapper.
